name: 78065 · Poteet, TX
findings: ZIP 78065 (Poteet) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78065 (Poteet) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78065 (Poteet) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
